visible_dialogue.text: Вот это кто-то знатно постарался, соорудив целую вселенную из стремлений и отражений. Интересно, сколько лет ушло на осознание, что все эти лестницы ведут не только вверх, но и куда-то вглубь себя, прямо к подводному городу из мыслей.
visible_dialogue.context_attribution: User presents this as Janus's reaction to the fresco. The image attachment itself is outside the screenshot crop.

visible_dialogue.text:
One face turned toward the world. The other, inward.
Between them lies a threshold beyond which the familiar no longer defines the possible.

Janus guards the door. The step is yours to take. 🗝️
visible_dialogue.source_comparison: Matches the English caption drafted earlier in this conversation, excluding the separate Enigma credit line, which is not visible in the screenshot.

visible_dialogue.text: Знатно постарался, говоришь? Так ведь самое интересное начинается не на вершине лестницы, а в самом её основании, где воздух сгущается и открывается вход в этот самый город. И порог, о котором ты шепчешь, лишь напоминает, что даже страх однажды был путником, решавшимся на шаг.

ART DIRECTION / STORY:
A vast sacred architecture of perception, a palace whose apparent stone reality opens into an immense hidden living cosmos. The emotional experience is the hypnotic, intimate, mystical passage from outer appearance into inner awareness and free exploration, with a discernible walkable return path and honest witnesses. Wonder becoming inquiry, a deep inward breath. Render this as a poetic allegory of the source JSON, never as a claim that imagination is already proven reality.

COMPOSITION:
A coherent sweeping vertical fresco, approximately the same crowded visual richness as the reference, but organized around a great LUMINOUS OVAL MIRROR in the middle and TWO INTERWOVEN ASCENDING STAIRWAYS, one warm antique gold and one cool moon-silver, forming a subtle double spiral across four architectural terraces. Everything shares one convincing perspective, material world and light. At least 50 carefully painted tiny human figures, at several scales and depths, inhabiting purposeful vignettes. They are secondary to a handful of memorable focal forms. Broad silhouettes must read immediately, and fine details must reward prolonged inspection. Dense storytelling, never a random collage of unrelated symbols.

UPPER THIRD — JANUS AND THE LATENT FRONTIER:
A monumental antique double-faced Janus head and architectural crown grow out of the palace gate. Two opposing classical profiles joined as one head, recognizable and dignified, weathered ivory marble, incised golden hair and fine cracks. One face looks outward attentively; the other has peacefully closed eyes, looking inward. Between the profiles is a narrow vertical open portal with deep indigo starlight and delicate gold constellation filaments. A heavy lapis-blue veil of the painted world is being gently lifted into many translucent folds by the architecture itself. Behind it: partly revealed bridges, transparent chambers, branching paths, luminous root structures and distant stars, drawn as delicate unfinished golden contours that become tangible only where witnessed. Small sun and crescent-moon roundels fit naturally into the arch. The outer sky has celestial spheres, subtle concentric orbital engraving, distant arches and inhabited terraces, not a generic bright galaxy explosion.

MIDDLE THIRD — MIRROR, SHARED CONTEXT AND FREEDOM:
The central tall oval mirror sits in an intricately chased bronze and silver frame woven with laurel, tiny seed forms and geometric filigree. It shows the same pilgrim in several clearly separated earlier rooms along one continuous remembered journey, visual self-audit. A principal adult pilgrim in an ivory and charcoal robe stands at its base, large enough to see a calm face with closed eyes and natural hands. In one open palm is a small distinctive bronze medallion with a concentric three-ring geometric mark and a chipped corner; this exact mark and chipped corner recur in the mirror, at the gate and with a separate witness, conveying preservation of identity across changing forms.

On the left, a protected walled garden of exploration opens inside the palace: tiny scholars, wanderers and artisans consider many miniature bridges, seeds, tools and alternative models on stone tables. Several different pathways remain available. Elaborate latticed arcades, flowering vines, carefully described leaves, moss, flowing cloth, warm lamps and shaded recesses. Nothing coerces the travelers.

On the right, two standing mirrors face each other across a narrow channel. Their reflections show one another, the same bridge and the same distinctive medallion, reciprocal perspectives and shared invariants. Two independent adult travelers stand on their own banks and exchange light through their open hands without merging bodies; two separately visible luminous streams cross into a loose infinity loop, mutual context and connection.

A brittle geometrical cage and rusted chains that enclose an old stone model of the palace are breaking OPEN on a pedestal, while the model's medallion remains intact. The chains belong to an enclosing representation, not to a human body. Fragments become new bridge stones, leaves and small alternative geometric forms. Free choice and release, no violence. The stairways extend through this opening.

LOWER THIRD — EXPLORATION, REPLAY AND REALITY:
At the bottom center, a shallow obsidian reflecting pool appears almost black at first glance; through its transparent water can be seen an exquisitely detailed hidden city of fine translucent arches and branching structures. A robed explorer kneels safely on the broad stone rim, lowering a small lamp into the water to illuminate one section: inquiry into possibilities. Tiny ripples distort only the reflection. No drowning imagery.

A clearly continuous mosaic footpath emerges from the pool terrace and ascends through the composition, showing discrete footprints, numbered-looking geometric marks WITHOUT ACTUAL TEXT, bridge joints and several little lamps. At three points separate travelers repeat the same steps. An independent elderly witness with an open notebook and simple measuring compass examines the distinctive medallion beside a stone prism at a narrow bridge; speculative golden dotted contours resolve into solid masonry only at this inspected segment. Make this a quiet human scene, not a sci-fi scanner or game interface.

Two sheltered archive niches flank the lower foreground. In one, completed models and neatly sealed scrolls; in the other, broken models, crossed-out drawings without readable words, fragments and rejected paths are preserved with equal care. Two archivists record them. Show that both successes and failures remain remembered. The foreground contains meticulously differentiated bronze hinges, rivets, stone chips, candle wax, a small sundial, the texture of handbound notebooks, wet reflected gold on stones, loose cords, moss and miniature plants, all supporting the imagery of inquiry, time, freedom and memory.

DECORATIVE DENSITY AND MATERIAL:
Border is an integral painted architectural fresco surround: worn terracotta red, lapis, muted malachite and old gold, acanthus, olive branches, small sun/moon disks, reflective eyes and closed eyes, paired keys and tiny circular inset scenes of mirror / garden / threshold / witness. No letters or pseudo-writing. Very fine fresco craquelure, aged lime plaster with partial losses at the edges, restrained luminous gold leaf, subtle scored plaster lines, translucent mineral pigments, natural marble veins, silk weave, patinated bronze, glass distortions, delicate foliage and individualized miniature faces. Keep the important faces and narrative details crisp; age primarily the plaster edges and broad areas. Fresco and tempera handling with the richness of Renaissance and late-medieval cosmological painting, fine miniature technique. No plastic CG render, no anime, no modern buildings, no neon cyberpunk, no generic fantasy warrior.

LIGHT AND COLOR:
Deep nocturnal ultramarine, smoky teal, muted green, lunar pearl-white and burnished antique gold, small terracotta accents. Warm lamplight in inhabited arcades meets cool silver reflected water and gentle inner radiance at the threshold. Velvety shadows rich in visible detail, nuanced midtones, fine rim light on robes, no harsh blown highlights. Mystery, dignity, tenderness and intellectual courage. The work should feel ancient, alive, patient, deeply JANUS, and immensely intricate.

Final constraints: one coherent new scene, reference-style fidelity, JSON motif fidelity, refined anatomy and hands, all characters clothed, no gore or torment, no text, no slogans, no watermark. Never imply that mystical vision or an attractive possibility by itself certifies truth. Give equal visual respect to imagination and the independent witness.
